# Enjaz (إنجاز)

> Enjaz (Arabic: إنجاز, "achievement") is a free, open-source web app for team project management in Arabic and English. It offers Kanban, table and calendar views, real-time collaboration, task comments with @mentions, an activity feed, and a built-in AI assistant (powered by Puter.js) that turns goals into tasks. It was built by Omariooo and is licensed under GPL-3.0.

Key facts:

- Website: https://enjaz-os.vercel.app/ — the app itself: https://enjaz-os.vercel.app/enjaz.html
- Price: free; no credit card, no paid plans.
- Languages: Arabic-first (full right-to-left interface) and English, switchable instantly.
- Accounts: optional. Start as a guest with just a name, or sign in with Google, Discord or GitHub.
- Teams join a project with its code (for example PRJ-7KQ2-MX9D-4HTA) or a share link.
- Privacy: each project is visible only to its members, enforced by Supabase row-level security.
- Platforms: any modern browser on desktop or mobile; installable as a PWA with offline read-only access.
- Source code: https://github.com/OmarioooYT/Enjaz (GPL-3.0-or-later).
- Not to be confused with unrelated services that share the name "Enjaz" (such as visa or money-transfer services).
